Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (L/L154/L154n1639.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianyin Xiu. Tianyin Yuanxiu owns the retained deployment: raises the meeting of the two old worthies, the one who gave tiger cries and the one who laughed and called him a master, and says whoever recognizes the full workings before their eyes needs no how-or-what but enters with the single blade, while a blind turtle and lame turtle cannot carry it on.

Senses.Explanation: Two questions folded into one, and the masters who bar the asking at the gate. Xinghua Cunjiang opens his hall with incense for his late teacher Linji and tells the assembly that today he asks no how-or-what but bids them enter with the single blade, Ciming Chuyuan rules that just going like that is already too much and any how-or-what merely kneads mud into water, Foyan Qingyuan contrasts the ancients' painstaking answers with descendants who shout the moment you enter the gate, no how-or-what at all, only afraid you might not understand, Wu'an Puning sizes up the half-believing who ask one line today and one tomorrow and still come asking their how-or-what, solemn and courtly, and Qianyan Yuanzhang has the drum sound, the assembly gather, host and guest change places, and no one asks how-or-what, the enjoyment ready-made as it is. Sanfeng Hanyue bathes the Buddha and promises a ladle of foul water in advance to any of them who stirs lips and tongue and steps forward to ask a how-or-what, Poshan Haiming traces Daruma's words and Linji's blows to the grant of the sacred seat straight to the common man with no how-or-what, and that as knowing where it hurts, Miyun Yuanwu at the furnace opening bids whoever transcends buddha and ancestor skip the how-or-what and meet the Tongxuan staff, Feiyin Tongrong warns the retreat assembly that in the red furnace of neither releasing nor holding, to be about to how-or-what is already to lose body and life, and Tianyin Yuanxiu raises the two old worthies' tiger-roar meeting and says whoever recognizes it needs no how-or-what but enters with the single blade.
